title: SKernel configuration
description: Settings for the options left off SKernel's command line, read from skernel.json or skernel.json.dist in the project root.

$schema.description: The schema that describes this file.

php.description: The managed PHP version: major.minor for that branch's latest release, or an exact major.minor.patch.

runtime.description: A micro.sfx that replaces the managed micro runtime, relative to the project root.

output.description: The package path, relative to the project root; by default target/<name>.

composer.description: The Composer binary that installs the packaged copy, a path or a name looked up in PATH.

dev.description: Whether the development dependencies are installed into the package.

phar.description: Whether packaging stops at the PHAR instead of a standalone binary.
